audit_event.timestamp: PostHog event timestamp; the durable database row retains actor_id, workspace_id, target_resource_id, action, and created_at

alerts.name: ItemTraxx security probes by IP or session
alerts.query: SELECT principal_type, principal_hash, uniqExact(request_id) AS security_events FROM (SELECT 'ip' AS principal_type, properties.client_ip_hash AS principal_hash, properties.request_id AS request_id FROM events WHERE event = 'security_event' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND properties.client_ip_hash != '' AND properties.request_id != '' UNION ALL SELECT 'session' AS principal_type, properties.session_hash AS principal_hash, properties.request_id AS request_id FROM events WHERE event = 'security_event' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND properties.session_hash != '' AND properties.request_id != '') GROUP BY principal_type, principal_hash

alert.notification_destination: Slack channel selected in the PostHog alert form

alerts.name: ItemTraxx authentication failures by IP or session
alerts.query: SELECT principal_type, principal_hash, uniqExact(request_id) AS auth_failures FROM (SELECT 'ip' AS principal_type, properties.client_ip_hash AS principal_hash, properties.request_id AS request_id FROM events WHERE event = 'edge_request' AND toInt64(properties.status) IN (401, 403) AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 2 MINUTE AND properties.client_ip_hash != '' AND properties.request_id != '' UNION ALL SELECT 'session' AS principal_type, properties.session_hash AS principal_hash, properties.request_id AS request_id FROM events WHERE event = 'edge_request' AND toInt64(properties.status) IN (401, 403) AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 2 MINUTE AND properties.session_hash != '' AND properties.request_id != '') GROUP BY principal_type, principal_hash

alert.notification_destination: Slack channel selected in the PostHog alert form

alerts.name: ItemTraxx item enumeration tripwire
alerts.query: SELECT properties.actor_hash AS actor_hash, uniqExact(properties.target_resource_hash) AS distinct_targets FROM events WHERE event = 'audit_event' AND properties.action IN ('read_target', 'denied_read_target') AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 60 SECOND AND properties.actor_hash != '' AND properties.target_resource_hash != '' GROUP BY actor_hash

alert.notification_destination: Slack channel selected in the PostHog alert form
alert.reliable_tripwire_query: SELECT count() AS tripwires FROM events WHERE event = 'security_event' AND properties.category = 'enumeration_tripwire' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE

alerts.name: ItemTraxx edge 5xx rate
alerts.query: SELECT 100.0 * uniqExactIf(properties.request_id, toInt64(properties.status) >= 500 AND properties.error_code = 'unhandled_error') / greatest(uniqExact(properties.request_id), 1) AS error_rate_percent FROM events WHERE event = 'edge_request' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND properties.request_id != ''

notification_setup.recommended: Use PostHog's native Slack destination in each saved HogQL insight alert.
steps: Save each HogQL insight in the itemtraxx-web project.
Open Monitor > Alerts, select New alert, choose the numeric value column and the evaluation mode listed above.
Set the threshold, choose Real time, and attach the authorized Slack workspace and security channel.
Simulate each alert against recent data before enabling it.

webhook_alternative.destination_type: Webhook URL in the PostHog alert notification form
receiver_requirements: Require an unguessable, rotated secret in the webhook URL or receiver-side allowlist.
Validate the PostHog alert payload and rate-limit the receiver.
